title: MV + MZ Add HP bars above Enemies in Chrono Engine!

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
This is a modified version of MOG EventIndicators that comes with Chrono Engine. It adds a new comment that draws HP bars over enemies.
Free for use in non-commercial and commercial games.
Follow Moghunter's
terms of use
My own additional terms are you can edit and redistribute it as long as you leave in the credits to Moghunter and myself. You cannot sell it or use it for AI training.
RPG Maker MV + MZ Chrono Engine HP Bars over Map Enemies by AquaEcho
A mod to MOG_EventIndicators to allow Chrono Engine to show HP bars above Enemies

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
If you want a demo, download Chrono Engine and just replace the MOG EventIndicators file there with my edited version. Chrono Engine is compatible with FOSSIL so it will work in MV and MZ
